the development and application of statistical and computational methods for the analysis of single cell transcriptomics data, with the ultimate goal to provide a comprehensive characterization of human cell heteroge- neity.
the development of computational methods for the identification of molecular signatures of cell identity in single cells.
the development of computational tools for the unbiased extraction of gene signatures that can be used to recognize cell types at individual cell level.
